# Tapped

> Tapped GmbH is an app and software development company based in Munich, Germany, specializing in Flutter applications for mobile and web. Founded in 2019 by Stefan Schaller and Julian Bissekkou.

## Main pages

- [English homepage](https://tapped.dev/): Flutter app development agency in Munich
- [German homepage](https://tapped.dev/de/): Flutter Agentur in München
- [Services](https://tapped.dev/services/) / [Leistungen](https://tapped.dev/de/services/)
- [Projects](https://tapped.dev/work/) / [Projekte](https://tapped.dev/de/work/)
- [About](https://tapped.dev/about/) / [Über uns](https://tapped.dev/de/about/)
- [Contact](https://tapped.dev/contact/) / [Kontakt](https://tapped.dev/de/contact/)
- [Jobs](https://tapped.dev/jobs/): no open roles currently

## Selected work

- [VVS Mobil](https://tapped.dev/work/vvs-mobil/): Flutter mobility app for Stuttgart, with MENTZ
- [FCBinside](https://tapped.dev/work/fcbinside/): FC Bayern news app
- [Appella](https://tapped.dev/work/appella/): GDPR-compliant music school app
- [AurumTools](https://tapped.dev/work/aurum-tools/): Flutter workshop app for goldsmiths (Kaddick) on iOS, Android and the web, with [product page](https://www.kaddick.de/aurumtool/) and [YouTube intro](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=iefLNMQhrmM)
- [Storyways](https://tapped.dev/work/storyways/)
- [VVS Cycle Planner](https://tapped.dev/work/vvs-cycle-planner/)
- [Die Ringe Bodyworkout](https://tapped.dev/work/die-ringe/)
